description_en: Queries a single site image transformation configuration
description_zh: 查询单条站点图片转换配置
name: GetImageTransform

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The configuration ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869056.html operation to obtain the configuration ID
parameters.name: config_id

AutoAvif.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable adaptive AVIF. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
AutoAvif.description_zh:
自适应avif。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

AutoWebp.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable adaptive WebP. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
AutoWebp.description_zh:
自适应webp。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

ConfigType.description_en:
The configuration type. Valid values:
global: global configuration.
rule: rule configuration
ConfigType.description_zh:
配置类型。取值范围：
global：全局配置；
rule：规则配置；

Enable.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable image transformation. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
Enable.description_zh:
是否开启图片转换。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

Rule.description_en:
The rule content, which uses a conditional expression to match user requests. This parameter does not need to be set when you add a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
Match specified requests: Set the value to a custom expression, such as (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
Rule.description_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")

RuleEnable.description_en:
The rule switch. This parameter does not need to be set when you add a global configuration. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
RuleEnable.description_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

RuleName.description_en: The rule name. This parameter does not need to be set when you add a global configuration
RuleName.description_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数

Sequence.description_en: The rule execution order. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Sequence.description_zh: 规则执行顺序。数值越小越优先执行

SiteVersion.description_en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. The default value is version 0
SiteVersion.description_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
